info.title: Airline Management API - Flight Booking Dialog
info.description: OpenAPI definition migrated from the legacy VB.NET WinForms handler `FlightsForm.BtnBook_Click` (qualified name `Forms.FlightsForm.FlightsForm.BtnBook_Click.2.Object.EventArgs`). The legacy handler resolves the currently selected flight from the grid, opens the `BookFlightForm` dialog for that flight, and refreshes the flight list afterwards. This endpoint exposes the read-only step that loads the flight shown in that dialog. Booking creation is handled by a separate endpoint (`BookFlightForm.BtnBook_Click`).

get.summary: Open the booking dialog for a selected flight
get.description:
Migrated from the legacy `FlightsForm.BtnBook_Click` handler (qualified name `Forms.FlightsForm.FlightsForm.BtnBook_Click.2.Object.EventArgs`).

Legacy behavior:
1. `GetSelectedFlightId()` reads the `Id` column of the selected row in the flights grid. If no row is selected, the legacy UI shows the warning "Please select a flight." (in the API this case is represented by a missing or invalid `flightId`, returned as 400 or 404).
2. `BookFlightForm(flightId)` loads the flight through `FlightRepository.GetById`. If the flight does not exist, the legacy form shows "Flight not found." and closes (404). If `AvailableSeats` is less than 1, the legacy form shows "No available seats on this flight." and closes (409).
3. On success, the flight details shown in the booking dialog are returned: flight number, route, departure date and time, and price.

This operation is read-only. It does not create a booking and does not change seat counts. The booking itself is created by `POST /flights/{flightId}/bookings`.

parameters.name: flightId
parameters.description: Unique numeric identifier of the selected flight (legacy grid column `Id`, obtained via `GetSelectedFlightId()`).

200.description: Flight found and has at least one available seat. The booking dialog can be opened for this flight.

400.description: Invalid `flightId` (not a valid 32-bit positive integer). Equivalent to a grid selection with no usable `Id` value.

example.message: flightId must be a positive 32-bit integer.

401.description: Unauthorized. The legacy handler performs no authentication check. Reserved for the API gateway if authentication is added during migration.

403.description: Forbidden. The legacy handler performs no authorization check. Reserved for future role-based access control.

404.description: Flight not found (legacy: 'Flight not found.' message, form closed). Also returned when no flight is selected in the grid (legacy: 'Please select a flight.').

409.description: No seats available (legacy: 'No available seats on this flight.' warning, form closed). This is an API-level mapping of a business rule; the HTTP status 409 is an assumption.

example.message: No available seats on this flight.
An unexpected error occurred while loading the flight.

FlightBookingDialog.description: Flight details shown in the legacy BookFlightForm (`lblFlightInfo`).

priceFormatted.description: Price in currency format, equivalent to legacy `Price.ToString("C")`.

availableSeats.description: Number of seats still available. Always at least 1 for a successful response (legacy `AvailableSeats < 1` check).

message.description: Human-readable error message. Mirrors the legacy MessageBox text.
